name: tma_align_input_scale
description: DeepGEMM TMA scale-layout adapter. Semantically this is a layout operation only: values are unchanged, but a non-contiguous input is transposed and padded so each column is 16-byte aligned (M padded to a multiple of 16/element_size) and returned as a transposed view. For an already row-major contiguous input the native fast path returns the input tensor itself unchanged; otherwise it returns a newly allocated padded buffer view. The reference returns input_scale directly. input_scale is a two-dimensional fp32 activation-scale tensor [M,K]; the suites exercise fp32 inputs. The output therefore aliases the input only on the contiguous fast path.
